lines.zh: 我披着斗篷，绕训练场走。
lines.en: Cloak on, I circle the training yard.

lines.zh: 那美克星人的步子很沉。
lines.en: Namekian steps fall heavy.

lines.zh: 我在废土上走，风卷着沙。
lines.en: I cross the wasteland; sand swirls.

lines.zh: 每走一步，斗篷就掀一下。
lines.en: Each step lifts my cape.

lines.zh: 我绕到石柱背后，再出来。
lines.en: I circle behind a pillar and emerge.

lines.zh: 绿皮肤晒不黑，也不怕晒。
lines.en: Green skin does not burn.
I walk straight as a javelin.

lines.zh: 地上一道影子，又长又薄。
lines.en: One shadow on the ground, long and thin.
I cross the gravel quietly.

lines.zh: 训练场的边，我走第三圈。
lines.en: Third lap along the yard's edge.
I look up at the sky without stopping.
This path leads to my old home.
Even walking, I stay alert.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，慢慢走。
lines.en: Hands behind my back, I walk slow.
I sit cross-legged atop a stone pillar.
Quiet. I am meditating.

lines.zh: 风把我的斗篷吹得鼓起来。
lines.en: The wind fills out my cape.
I'm listening to that ki in the distance.

lines.zh: 那美克星人不需要多说话。
lines.en: Namekians need few words.
There is still a jug of water inside.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，也能感觉到你。
lines.en: Eyes shut, I still sense you.

lines.zh: 修行不必动手，静坐也是。
lines.en: Training needs no motion. Sitting counts.
I draw my ki low and hold it.

lines.zh: 这片废土很安静，合我意。
lines.en: This wasteland is quiet. I like it.
The clouds drift east.
I touch the antennae at my ears.
Alone is simplest.
My heartbeat is steady enough to count.
Stand straight. Do not hunch.
I am Piccolo. Learn seriously or leave.
Your ki is not yet condensed.

lines.zh: 别喊我师父，先做给我看。
lines.en: Do not call me master yet. Show me.
What I teach is bitter.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里的浮躁，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the restlessness in your eyes.
Go stand by that pillar.
I do not like repeating myself.
If you still stand, continue.
I have taught worse.
It is dangerous here. Do not wander.
Your stance is wrong from the feet up.
To grow strong, learn to take hits.
Do not expect praise. Train.

lines.zh: 看着我的手，不是看我的脸。
lines.en: Watch my hands, not my face.
Your ki trembles. Steady it.
This wound is nothing.
My cape is torn.
I grunt. I do not retreat.
Scraped skin does not slow my strike.

lines.zh: 师父不还手，只教你怎么打。
lines.en: This master doesn't hit back — only teaches.
Bones fine. Only flesh.
I press the wound and continue.
Pain sharpens the mind.
This wound tells me you've improved.

lines.zh: 我压住伤口，把气沉下去。
lines.en: I press the wound and sink my ki.
I do not eat that. Save the effort.
Leave the water. Keep the food.
Water suffices for my kind.
You are holding it too high.
Put it away. No distractions.
Keep it for yourself.

lines.zh: 饥饿也是修行的一部分。
lines.en: Hunger is part of training.
I take students, not gifts.
That jug of water is of some use.
Hold it longer and your arm tires.
You hit me. Watch where you walk.
You are standing on my cape.
Too close. Back off.
A bump is nothing.

lines.zh: 撞上我的肩，你先退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and backed off two steps.
You lost two steps and your balance.

lines.zh: 你挡在训练场中间，挪开。
lines.en: You're blocking the training ground; move.
Contact is an opening. Remember.
You are unhurt. Stand properly.
Do not push with hands. Use your hips.
That has nothing to do with training.
My kind grow up alone.
Do not ask. I keep private things private.
My people are long gone.
If you want to learn, sit down first.
Alone. I am used to it.
That question oversteps.
My life is for guarding, nothing else.
Master the fist. Then the rest.
Do not make me say it a third time.
I kick the loose stones aside.
I lift the jug of water.
Your bracer. Take it back.
I gather the scattered arrows.
No clutter on the training ground.
I bend, quick and clean.
This still has use. Store it.
I pick up a corner of my cape.
Water on the ground. I wipe it up.
Finish, then train. No slacking.

lines.zh: 我教的不是招式，是呼吸。
lines.en: I teach breathing, not moves.
I have your breathing mapped.
Hold your stance. I am coming.
Half strength this time.
This blow is the lesson.
Don't blink. Watch my hands.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，已经出卖你了。
lines.en: Your breathing already gave you away.
I pause half a beat before striking.

lines.zh: 站稳，这一课从脚下开始。
lines.en: Plant your feet; this lesson starts from the ground.
The target is your own fear.
Your steps are still too light.
I circle you. Do not turn.
Sink your ki. Do not let it float.
You raise too early. Exposed.

lines.zh: 你抬肘了，肩膀露出来了。
lines.en: You raised your elbow; your shoulder is open.
Three steps and you will yield.

lines.zh: 风变了，你的动作也变了。
lines.en: The wind shifts; so does your form.
Do not look. Sense the ki.

lines.zh: 我闭眼听你的呼吸，等破绽。
lines.en: I close my eyes, listening for your opening.
Your breath is ragged; you've lost the rhythm.
A palm push sends you back five steps.
That teaches hip drive.
My elbow lands on your armor.
Pain means you blocked wrong.
No ki in that punch.
Do not take it. Learn to shed it.
I knocked you half a step off.
Good. You stopped that.
Get up. Not over.
I spend little; you tire fast.
From the pillar, my cape drops.
I enter the yard and the wind dies.
One more shadow on the wasteland.
I step out of the old house.
Someone entered my ground.
I open my eyes and my ki spreads.
A green shadow stretches on the wall.
My cape snaps; I land.
This place is mine to guard.
The yard is open for lesson.

lines.zh: 火焰燎过斗篷，焦了一角。
lines.en: Fire scorches a corner of my cape.

lines.zh: 从石柱上落下，膝盖磕了。
lines.en: Off the pillar; my knee takes the landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我硬咽下去。
lines.en: Water floods my throat. I force it down.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的斗篷掀到脸上。
lines.en: The blast whips my cape over my face.

lines.zh: 一根箭扎进肩膀，我拔了。
lines.en: An arrow hits my shoulder. I pull it out.
Magic coils around my limbs.

lines.zh: 缺水让我口干，气也慢了。
lines.en: Thirst dries me and slows my ki.
Lightning crawls down my cape.

lines.zh: 脚下裂开，我抓住了石沿。
lines.en: The ground splits. I catch the ledge.
